activity_summary: Rehearsal of Richard the Third began with the street still audible. You set the work on the company's drum, and you told them a noise from the road was not theirs. A shout came. Cowley said he heard it and was not going. Nobody turned to the lane on the second drum. Larkham's list stayed what it had been: people running toward the noise, and this company not among them.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Set the drum against the street, and refused the road a second time.

entities.name: Richard Cowley
entities.context: Heard the shout, looked at Pope, and did not go.

entities.name: Humphrey Larkham
entities.context: Separated the outside noise from the drum, and did not add a figure.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Stayed on his cue, and meant to be louder than the memory of the gate.

entities.name: Richard III
entities.context: Mentioned in The scene, with the street in it
